policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM study_plans plan
  WHERE ((plan.id = study_plan_items.plan_id) AND ((plan.user_id = auth.uid()) OR is_admin(auth.uid())))))
policies.policyname: Students read items in their own study plans

policies.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'interview-recordings'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM interview_attempts a
  WHERE ((a.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (a.upload_status = ANY (ARRAY['awaiting_upload'::text, 'uploading'::text])) AND (a.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND ((objects.name = a.recording_path) OR (objects.name = a.transcription_audio_path))))))
